context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on dealings with ministries
purpose: Teach: 主任/取り付け/採択/円滑/送付/法務省/官庁/査定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔は法務省に直接書類を送付しに行ったもんだ。
lines.en: Back in my day, we'd go to the Justice Ministry ourselves with the documents.
lines.style: Settled voice, slightly distant. Memory pulling him back. Warm at the edges, not judgmental. Unhurried rhythm, like settling into a familiar story.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今でも、主任が一度は顔を出して、円滑な関係作りに努めています。
lines.en: Even now, our manager makes a point of visiting to build good working relations with them.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Steady cadence. Taking care to choose words precisely. Respectful nod to the practice, neither defensive nor boastful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 査定はうやむやにせず、官庁側の見方も尊重しろ。
lines.en: Don't gloss over the evaluation. Respect how the ministry views it too.
lines.style: Firmer now. Weight on the directive words. Not harsh — the tone of someone who's seen mistakes. Brief, expectant pause at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。今期は採択を確実にしたく、慎重に動いています。
lines.en: Yes. I want to secure adoption this term, so we're being very careful with how we proceed.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly careful. Respectful pace. Shows he's taken the advice seriously. Voice tilts slightly toward reassurance without asking for it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 装備の取り付け工事も、現場任せにせず確認しろ。
lines.en: Don't leave the equipment installation work to the field staff alone — verify it yourself.
lines.style: Direct, no-nonsense. Clipped emphasis on the responsibility. Not angry, but carrying the weight of experience. The tone of someone who's cleaned up after oversights.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, genuine deference. Brief response that carries real acknowledgment. No rushing the words. Looking him in the eye through the voice.
